After reading more tests, it appears that many are kind of stubbed in and will be fully implemented later. I'm not sure what feedback to give.

FYI you can put multiple .cpp files into a single test executable. That saves a lot of meson.build copy/paste. They still run separately, so if one fails the others still run. So you could have a test_chassis_smp that included all 3 files below.
